primary_result: On the isolated 100-canonical-scene, 400-variant Haze4K official-test development partition, the fully outer-scene-cross-fitted low-capacity proxy did not realize the previously established bounded-oracle headroom. Its OOF spatial policy improved over the official keep output by only 0.0150 dB scene-mean PSNR (20,000-resample scene bootstrap 95% CI -0.0141 to +0.0520 dB), whose upper bound remained below the frozen +0.10 dB materiality threshold. Only 4/100 scenes gained at least +0.10 dB (Wilson 95% CI 0.0157 to 0.0984), so even the prevalence upper bound was below the frozen 0.20 requirement. Spatial-minus-identical-predictor-uniform and spatial-minus-shuffled-target contrasts were also 0.0150 dB, with respective upper bounds +0.0512 and +0.0520 dB, both below +0.10 dB. The proxy used keep on 99.06% of tiles, strengthen on 0.94%, and weaken on none; two of five outer folds selected the preregistered keep-only fallback. PSNR harm occurred in 6/100 scenes and its Wilson upper bound was 0.1248, so the frozen PSNR safety gate did not pass, while SSIM and color harm each occurred in 1/100 scenes with upper bounds 0.0545 and passed their gates.
gate_reasons: all 100 canonical clear scenes and 400 nested haze variants completed one fixed-checkpoint inference, five outer scene folds, inner selection confined to outer-training scenes, and complete OOF image replay with no network or module training

the upper 95 percent scene-bootstrap bound for OOF spatial-minus-keep PSNR was +0.0520 dB, below the frozen +0.10 dB materiality threshold and therefore establishing futility for the frozen proxy family
the upper Wilson bound for scenes gaining at least +0.10 dB was 0.0984, below the frozen 0.20 breadth threshold
the upper bootstrap bounds for spatial-minus-identical-predictor-uniform and spatial-minus-shuffled-target PSNR were +0.0512 and +0.0520 dB, both below their frozen +0.10 dB thresholds
the Wilson upper bound for scene-level PSNR harm was 0.1248 and did not satisfy the frozen requirement to remain below 0.10
the Wilson upper bounds for scene-level SSIM and color harm were both 0.0545 and passed their frozen 0.10 safety limits
the protected 150-scene candidate-confirmation asset and NH-HAZE were not delivered or accessed
scientific_interpretation: The preceding GT oracle established large spatial intervention headroom, but this experiment shows that the frozen low-capacity ridge and its fixed deployment-visible input/output/Decoder[2] moment representation cannot predict and safely realize that headroom out of scene under the preregistered action and threshold family. The dominant keep choice and keep-only selection in two folds indicate that conservative inner selection found little stable actionable signal; the few strengthen decisions produced negligible mean utility and six material PSNR-harm scenes. This is a qualified negative result for the tested proxy family, not evidence that all deployment-visible representations or all learnable network-internal modules are impossible. The typed FAIL authorizes no adjacent retuning, module construction, candidate-confirmation access, or NH-HAZE evaluation.
competing_explanation: The negative result may reflect under-capacity of weighted linear ridge, insufficiency of pooled first- and second-moment features, target noise from small RGB-MSE differences, scene-domain shift, conservative inner harm screening, hard tile independence, or mismatch between output-residual action utility and what the frozen Decoder[2] representation encodes. Conversely, the large GT oracle gain may partly be an optimization advantage from per-tile access to clear targets rather than a learnable haze-state signal. Distinguishing these explanations requires substantively new, independently justified evidence or representation, not post-hoc retuning of this closed family.
limitations: This is development-screening evidence from 100 isolated Haze4K official-test scenes; it is not candidate confirmation or real-haze external validation.
The 400 haze variants and all tiles are nested within 100 canonical clear scenes and were not treated as independent statistical units.
GT generated proxy targets only inside outer-training partitions and scored OOF outputs; no GT-derived quantity was supplied as an OOF predictor input.

The result applies to the frozen weighted ridge, fixed feature moments, three residual scales, 32-pixel grid, alpha grid, threshold grid, and harm-screening rule; it does not exhaust nonlinear or end-to-end representations.

The equality of the three primary point estimates reflects OOF collapse of the matched uniform and shuffled-target controls to keep, not independent evidence that those policies behave identically in all possible designs.
The PSNR-harm upper bound crossed 0.10; this fails the frozen safety requirement but does not establish that the underlying harm prevalence is at least 10 percent because its lower bound was 0.0278.

The earlier engineering contract failure touched no scientific or protected data and was replaced once by the approved same-contract run with a new output identity; only the successful replacement provides scientific evidence.
